name: Jump
description: Jump is the #1 AI platform for advisors and financial professionals. The Jump connector gives Claude read-only access to your meeting data, contacts, and documents — the same data you already see in Jump. List and search meetings by date or keyword, retrieve full transcripts and AI-generated summaries, run semantic search across meeting and document content, and look up contacts and meeting participants. All access is scoped to your authenticated Jump account; nothing is created, changed, or deleted.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jump to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jump to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://my.jumpapp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jump MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jump provides these MCP tools: jump_get_document_content, jump_get_meeting_content, jump_list_documents, jump_list_meetings_beta, jump_search_jump_contact, jump_search_meeting_participants, jump_search_meetings, jump_semantic_document_search, and jump_semantic_meeting_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jump?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jump in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Jump requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jump is developed by Jump. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
